svg.title: Glyphcss diagrams & charts in an agent terminal
svg.desc:
Illustrative agent conversation: a user asks for weekly signups, and the agent replies with actual braille chart output from the bundled Glyphcss renderer. Example data.
Weekly signups
Signups
50 ┤ ⢀⡠⢄⣀ │ ⢀⡠⠒⠁ ⠉⠑⠒⠤ │ ⡠⠒⠁ 40 ┤ ⢀⠔⠁ │ ⡠⠊ 30 ┤ ⡠⢄⣀⡀ ⢀⠔⠁ │ ⡠⠊ ⠈⠉⠒⠒⠤⠊ │ ⢀⡠⢄⣀ ⡠⠊ 20 ┤ ⢀⡠⠒⠁ ⠉⠑⠒⠤⠊ └⠠⠒⠁───┬───────────┬────────────┬───────────┬ 2 4 6 8 Week
